Question: Indicate which characteristic of the whiplash direction of the nystagmus is characteristic of an acute peripheral non-positional vestibular syndrome:

Options:
opa. With visual fixation and in the primary position of the gaze changes or alternates the direction spontaneously and periodically.
opb. With visual fixation, it changes direction when looking to one side or the other.
opc. With visual fixation and in the primary position of the gaze it is vertical downwards pure, without horizontal component.
opd. Both with visual fixation and when canceling it is unidirectional.
